Consumers were found by reading each client's source. File references point into the draft repository.

| Class | Meaning | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| `native` | Used by live code of a working native client (macOS 1.4.5, Windows 1.4.5), including the WhispererKit modules macOS uses | Must stay compatible: shipped clients are not updated (nfr-12) |
| `external` | Used by an external party: acquirer, LiveKit and calendar webhooks, MCP and OAuth clients, links in emails and shared links, search engines | Must stay compatible |
| `web` | Used only by the draft web frontend | May change together with the v2 frontend |
| `unused` | No live consumer found | Not carried over unless D4 keeps it |
| `excluded` | Not part of the contract: the draft's own probes and monitoring | Not checked |

## /v1/ws/realtime

- **Slice:** S05 · **class:** `native` · **source:** `backend/src/meetassist/api/realtime.py:689`
- **Consumers:** ios (13), linux (20), macos (15), whispererkit (23), windows (23)
- **Authentication:** `header:authorization-bearer`, `subprotocol:whisperer-bearer`. Bearer token in the `Authorization` header, or (browsers) in `Sec-WebSocket-Protocol` as `whisperer-bearer, <token>`. Query-string tokens are NOT accepted. No token, invalid token, or slot refusal -> `ws.close(code=1008)` BEFORE accept. Under uvicorn a pre-accept close is turned into an HTTP 403 Forbidden handshake response, so clients never see close code 1008 for auth failures. An exception inside _resolve_user (DB down, JWT_SECRET unset -> RuntimeError, signed JWT without `sub` -> KeyError) is not caught and becomes HTTP 500 from uvicorn. No error frame is sent.
- **Discriminator:** `type`
- **Handshake:** 1) Edge: nginx `location ^~ /v1/ws/` proxies to the `ws` process role (fallback `api`), proxy_read/send_timeout 3600s, retries the handshake on another upstream on HTTP 503 (drain). 2) DrainMiddleware (pure ASGI): if the drain marker file exists, the handshake is refused with HTTP 503 `draining` (websocket.http.response extension) or, without the extension, a pre-accept close 1013 (-> HTTP 403). 3) Handler: extract token (Authorization, else subprotocol); resolve user; on failure close 1008 pre-accept (HTTP 403). 4) Acquire WS slot (per-user Redis pool + per-worker counter); on refusal close 1008 pre-accept (HTTP 403). 5) `accept(subprotocol='whisperer-bearer' | None)`. 6) Server immediately sends `ready` {user_id, timestamp} unprompted. 7) Client normally sends `hello` (Swift/C# clients send `{"type":"hello"}` only); server answers with a second `ready`, then (if the transcription role resolves) `transcription.mode`. 8) Client sends `session.start` {session_id} to bind a meeting; server answers `session.ack` and, if a roll was found, `transcript.restore`. 9) Steady state: binary audio frames + `audio.commit`/`ask`/`ask.transcript`/`vision`/`answer.stop`/`ping`; the server streams `transcript*`, `answer.*`, `error`, `pong`. Text frames are handled inline in arrival order except `ask`, `ask.transcript`, `vision`, which run as background tasks (AnswerGate, max 2 concurrent per socket, oldest is cancelled with finish_reason `superseded`).
- **Protocol version:** There is NO protocol version field, negotiation or capability exchange. `hello` carries only optional `language` and `session_id`; unknown fields are ignored. Compatibility is achieved by additive evolution: new binary codes 2/3 were added beside 0/1, the server decides the audio mode and announces it with `transcription.mode` (clients that ignore it keep sending WAV chunks, which always work), new server frames (`transcript.restore`, `transcription.error`, `answer.suppressed`, `answer.stopped`) are designed to be ignored by older clients (shipped clients drop unknown types), optional `id` on answer frames, optional `trigger` on ask frames. `hello` may be sent any number of times and is not required (the first `ready` is sent without it). Evolution rule implied by the code: never rename existing types/codes/fields; only add.
- **Resume:** No sequence-based replay. Each socket has fresh in-memory state (seq counter restarts at 1, answer ids restart at `a1`, history, restraint, quota cache). Reconnect resume is meeting-scoped: after reconnect the client re-sends `session.start` (or `hello` with `session_id`); the server re-binds the meeting after an ownership check and, only on `session.start`, restores the conversation roll from the Redis mirror `realtime roll` (TTL 30 min, max 20 000 utterances, appended per final utterance) or, if empty and the meeting is not ephemeral, from transcript_segments (max 2 000 rows). Restored utterances are treated as already answered and sent once as `transcript.restore` (after `session.ack`, trimmed from the head to ~512 KiB with `truncated:true`). Restore does nothing if the socket's roll is non-empty. `hello` with session_id binds but does NOT restore. Idempotency: `answer.stop` is idempotent (unknown/finished id -> count 0); `session.start` repeated is safe; ask/vision frames have no idempotency key (a resent ask produces a new answer). `transcript.seq` is per-socket, monotonic in audio arrival order with gaps allowed (empty/failed chunks), not a resume cursor. `session.end` drops the Redis mirror and triggers meeting post-processing. In-flight answers and transcriptions are cancelled when the socket closes (no terminal frame is sent then).

### Client → server frames

#### `hello`

json · class `native` · source `backend/src/meetassist/api/realtime.py:490`

Optional greeting; can be sent any number of times. Sets the recognition language and optionally binds a meeting (ownership-checked, no roll restore). Server replies `ready` and then (best effort) `transcription.mode`. If session_id is not owned -> `error` forbidden (then still `ready`). Shipped clients send only {"type":"hello"}. Every hello re-sets language (absent -> auto). A meeting bound via hello does not load the meeting title (used in prompts) — only session.start does.

Consumers: `shared/WhispererKit/Sources/Realtime/RealtimeClient.swift:433`, `linux-client/Sources/whisperer/LiveChannel.swift:67`, `shared/WhispererKit/Sources/Realtime/RealtimeClient.swift:433`, `shared/WhispererKit/Sources/Realtime/RealtimeClient.swift:433`, `windows-client/src/Whisperer/Ai/RealtimeClient.cs:414`

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes | "hello" |
| `language` | `string` | no | Speech recognition language. Trimmed, lower-cased; empty or "auto" (or non-string) means auto-detect per utterance (default). Stored for the socket; not the UI language. |
| `session_id` | `string` | no | UUID of an existing meeting owned by the user. Invalid/absent -> ignored. Not owned -> error `forbidden`. Binding here does not restore the roll. |

#### `session.start`

json · class `native` · source `backend/src/meetassist/api/realtime.py:513`

Bind (or unbind) the active meeting: transcript segments, AI executions and the Redis roll mirror are attached to it. Ownership checked (IDOR). Owned/absent -> `session.ack`, then `transcript.restore` if a roll was restored. Not owned -> socket is UNBOUND (session cleared) and `error` forbidden is sent, no ack. Also used after every reconnect.

Consumers: `ios-client/App/Features/Live/Model/LiveMeetingStore.swift:609`, `macos-client/Sources/MeetAssistApp/AppDelegate.swift:372`, `shared/WhispererKit/Sources/Realtime/RealtimeClient.swift:387`, `windows-client/src/Whisperer/Ai/RealtimeClient.cs:406`

| `type` | `string` | yes | "session.start" |
| `session_id` | `string\|null` | no | Meeting UUID. Absent/null/empty/unparseable -> explicit unbind (ack with session_id null). |

#### `audio.commit`

json · class `native` · source `backend/src/meetassist/api/realtime.py:444-456, backend/src/meetassist/api/realtime_persist.py:773`

Stream mode only: the client detected end of phrase for a speaker. The buffered PCM for that speaker is committed to the streaming ASR session in a background task (counts against the 3 in-flight transcription limit; silently dropped when saturated). Produces `transcript.partial`* then `transcript` (or nothing if empty, or `transcription.error`). seq is assigned at commit time. A commit dropped by the gate is not lost audio: the buffered PCM rolls into the next commit for that speaker. ASR/role failures surface as `transcription.error`, not `error`.

Consumers: `ios-client/App/Features/Live/Model/LiveMeetingStore.swift:594`, `linux-client/Sources/whisperer/LiveChannel.swift:163`, `macos-client/Sources/AI/LiveTranscriber.swift:323`, `macos-client/Sources/AI/SystemAudioTranscriber.swift:171`, `shared/WhispererKit/Sources/Realtime/RealtimeClient.swift:271`, `windows-client/src/Whisperer/Ai/RealtimeClient.cs:317`

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes | "audio.commit" |
| `speaker` | `string` | no | "me" (default when absent/empty); any other value is treated as "them". |

#### `ask`

json · class `native` · source `backend/src/meetassist/api/realtime.py:293, backend/src/meetassist/api/realtime.py:337-377, backend/src/meetassist/api/realtime_answer.py:742`

Typed or client-supplied question (chat, recap "what did I miss", system design). Runs in background. Context = whole meeting roll; does not move the answered/new-speech boundary. Flow: empty -> `error` empty_question (once) or `answer.suppressed` reason empty; unsafe -> `error` unsafe_request; known-exhausted quota -> `error` minutes_exhausted (once); rate cap -> `error` rate_limited; else `answer.start` -> `answer.delta`* [`answer.continue`] -> exactly one terminal `answer.done` or `error` (with id). NOTE: minutes_exhausted is told once per socket; every later ask/vision while exhausted gets NO frame at all (no answer.start, no terminal). An auto-triggered ask first passes the interjection gate (may yield `answer.suppressed`).

Consumers: `ios-client/App/Features/Live/Model/LiveMeetingStore.swift:171`, `linux-client/Sources/whisperer/LiveChannel.swift:136`, `macos-client/Sources/MeetAssistApp/AssistantAsk.swift:127`, `shared/WhispererKit/Sources/Realtime/RealtimeClient.swift:296`, `windows-client/src/Whisperer/Ai/RealtimeClient.cs:355`

#### `<binary:audio-chunk>`

binary, layout `u8 speaker (0 me, 1 them) + RIFF WAV, PCM16LE mono 16 kHz` · class `native` · source `backend/src/meetassist/api/realtime_session.py:417-448, backend/src/meetassist/api/realtime.py:417-436, backend/src/meetassist/api/realtime_limits.py:228-236, backend/src/meetassist/api/realtime_persist.py:667-730, backend/src/meetassist/core/audio_frames.py:128`

Finished phrase as WAV (chunk mode; the only mode older clients know). Layout: byte[0] = speaker code: 0x00 = me (microphone), 0x01 = them (system audio). bytes[1..] = a complete RIFF/WAVE file, PCM16 little-endian; clients send 16 kHz mono (server reads rate/channels from the fmt chunk, accepts 8-48 kHz, 1-2 channels; falls back to 16 kHz mono for duration if the header is unparseable). Typical chunk ~0.8 s / tens of KB. Frames > 2 MiB are silently dropped; frames beyond 3 in-flight transcriptions are silently dropped. seq is assigned on acceptance in arrival order. Produces `transcript` (non-empty text only); ASR provider failure -> `transcription.error` (once per failure series); transcription role not configured -> `error` transcription_unavailable on EVERY chunk; quota exhausted -> `error` minutes_exhausted once per socket, then chunks are dropped silently; too fast -> dropped, one `transcription.error` audio_rate_exceeded per socket.

Consumers: `ios-client/App/Features/Live/Model/LiveMeetingStore.swift:566`, `ios-client/App/Features/Live/Model/LiveMeetingStore.swift:583`, `linux-client/Sources/whisperer/LiveChannel.swift:89`, `linux-client/Sources/whisperer/LiveChannel.swift:98`, `macos-client/Sources/AI/LiveTranscriber.swift:367`, `macos-client/Sources/AI/LiveTranscriber.swift:490`, `macos-client/Sources/AI/SystemAudioTranscriber.swift:162`, `macos-client/Sources/AI/SystemAudioTranscriber.swift:266`, `shared/WhispererKit/Sources/Realtime/RealtimeClient.swift:243`, `shared/WhispererKit/Sources/Realtime/RealtimeClient.swift:261`, `windows-client/src/Whisperer/Ai/RealtimeClient.cs:285`, `windows-client/src/Whisperer/Ai/RealtimeClient.cs:300`

_None._

#### `<binary:audio-stream>`

binary, layout `u8 speaker (2 me, 3 them) + raw PCM16LE mono at transcription.mode sample_rate (24 kHz), 200 ms frames` · class `native` · source `backend/src/meetassist/api/realtime_session.py:420-448, backend/src/meetassist/api/realtime.py:427-441, backend/src/meetassist/api/realtime_persist.py:736-770, backend/src/meetassist/services/llm/live_transcription_session.py:63`

Continuous-stream piece (only after the server announced `transcription.mode` mode="stream"). Layout: byte[0] = 0x02 = me, 0x03 = them; bytes[1..] = raw headerless PCM16 little-endian mono at the announced sample_rate (24 000 Hz), nominally frame_ms=200 ms (9 600 bytes). Appended inline (in order, not under the transcription gate) to the per-speaker streaming ASR session; nothing is returned until `audio.commit`. Frames > 2 MiB dropped. Unknown first byte (>=4) or empty frame: silently dropped. Quota/pace rules as for chunks; role or provider failures -> `transcription.error`.

Consumers: `ios-client/App/Features/Live/Model/LiveMeetingStore.swift:566`, `ios-client/App/Features/Live/Model/LiveMeetingStore.swift:583`, `linux-client/Sources/whisperer/LiveChannel.swift:89`, `linux-client/Sources/whisperer/LiveChannel.swift:98`, `macos-client/Sources/AI/LiveTranscriber.swift:367`, `macos-client/Sources/AI/LiveTranscriber.swift:490`, `macos-client/Sources/AI/SystemAudioTranscriber.swift:162`, `macos-client/Sources/AI/SystemAudioTranscriber.swift:266`, `shared/WhispererKit/Sources/Realtime/RealtimeClient.swift:243`, `shared/WhispererKit/Sources/Realtime/RealtimeClient.swift:261`, `windows-client/src/Whisperer/Ai/RealtimeClient.cs:285`, `windows-client/src/Whisperer/Ai/RealtimeClient.cs:300`

## /v1/ws/sessions/{session_id}

- **Slice:** S05 · **class:** `native` · **source:** `backend/src/meetassist/api/websocket.py:104`
- **Consumers:** ios (4), macos (3), whispererkit (6)
- **Authentication:** `header:authorization-bearer`. Bearer token (access JWT or device API key) in Authorization header, or `whisperer-bearer` subprotocol; plus ownership of the meeting session close(1008) before accept() -> client receives HTTP 403 (no token / invalid token, non-UUID session_id, foreign or missing session, per-user or per-worker socket cap). All four cases are indistinguishable by design (anti-IDOR).
- **Discriminator:** `type`
- **Handshake:** 1) extract token (header, else whisperer-bearer subprotocol) and resolve user -> else close 1008 pre-accept (HTTP 403). 2) parse session_id as UUID -> else 1008. 3) ownership check -> else 1008. 4) acquire per-user socket slot in the general pool (channel label `sessions`) -> else 1008. 5) accept() with no subprotocol. 6) join the Redis pub/sub room `rt:room:<session_id>` (if Redis is down the socket still works but receives no room events). 7) server sends personal `session.state` {status: active} (no seq). 8) read loop: each text frame parsed with json.loads and dispatched on `type`; 600 s without any client frame ends the connection. Room events are pushed concurrently by a relay task.
- **Protocol version:** none
- **Resume:** none. Pub/sub keeps no history: events published while disconnected are lost. Room events carry `seq`, a per-session Redis INCR counter (key rt:room:seq:<session_id>, TTL 30 min refreshed on every publish) shared across all processes, so a client can detect gaps; history is meant to be restored from the /v1/ws/realtime `transcript.restore` frame (other endpoint). Personal replies (session.state on connect, ack, pong) carry no seq.

### Query parameters

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `string` | yes | PATH parameter (not query): meeting session UUID; must be owned by the caller. |

### Close codes

| Code | Reason | When | Source | Handled by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1008 | policy violation (pre-accept -> HTTP 403) | missing/invalid token | `backend/src/meetassist/api/websocket.py:113` | — |
| 1008 | policy violation (pre-accept -> HTTP 403) | session_id is not a UUID | `backend/src/meetassist/api/websocket.py:120` | — |
| 1008 | policy violation (pre-accept -> HTTP 403) | session not found or owned by another user | `backend/src/meetassist/api/websocket.py:125` | — |
| 1008 | policy violation (pre-accept -> HTTP 403) | per-user (8) or per-worker (500) socket cap reached | `backend/src/meetassist/api/websocket.py:129` | — |
| 1006 | no close frame | idle timeout: no client frame for 600 s -> loop breaks and the handler returns without close(); also on malformed client input (non-JSON text, JSON that is not an object, binary frame) which raises out of the handler | `backend/src/meetassist/api/websocket.py:147` | — |
| 1006 | abnormal closure (no close frame) | Observed by the client when the handler returns or raises after accept() without calling close(): uvicorn closes the TCP transport without a close frame. | `backend/Dockerfile:44` | — |
| 1011 | keepalive ping timeout (uvicorn) | Client does not answer protocol-level pings: uvicorn default --ws-ping-interval 20 s / --ws-ping-timeout 20 s (not overridden in the launch command). | `backend/Dockerfile:44` | — |
| 1012 | service restart (uvicorn) | Server shutdown while the socket is open (uvicorn closes open websockets immediately on SIGTERM). | `backend/src/meetassist/core/web/drain.py:7` | — |
| 1009 | message too big (protocol layer) | A single frame larger than --ws-max-size 12582912 bytes (12 MiB). | `backend/Dockerfile:44` | — |

### Handshake rejections

| HTTP status | Reason | When | Source | Handled by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 403 | HTTP 403 Forbidden instead of 101 (not a WS close code) | Any `ws.close(code=...)` issued BEFORE `ws.accept()`: uvicorn rejects the upgrade with HTTP 403, so the application close code (e.g. 1008) never reaches the client. Runtime: uvicorn[standard] (>=0.34; resolved 0.54 with websockets-sansio impl). | `backend/Dockerfile:44` | — |
| 503 | HTTP 503 `draining` before upgrade (not a WS close code) | Process drain marker file (/app/.drain) present: DrainMiddleware refuses every NEW websocket handshake with HTTP 503 body `draining` (nginx retries it on another upstream only under /v1/ws/); if the server lacked the websocket.http.response extension it would send close 1013 pre-accept, i.e. HTTP 403. | `backend/src/meetassist/core/web/drain.py:140` | — |

### Limits

| Limit | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|

## /v1/ws/voice

- **Slice:** S05 · **class:** `web` · **source:** `backend/src/meetassist/api/ai/voice_ws.py:708`
- **Consumers:** ios (3), web (13), whispererkit (13)
- **Authentication:** `header:authorization-bearer`, `subprotocol:whisperer-bearer`. Bearer token (access JWT or device API key) in Authorization header, or `whisperer-bearer` subprotocol; then a paid-plan gate No/invalid token or invalid sid: close(1008) before accept -> HTTP 403. Slot refusal: accept, send {t:error, code:retry_later}, close 1008. Gate refusal: accept, send {t:error, code:voice_disabled|upgrade_required|voice_switched_off}, close 1000. ws_metering.py is NOT used by this endpoint (it serves the /v1/ws/realtime answer and vision paths only).
- **Discriminator:** `t`
- **Handshake:** 1) resolve user from token -> else 1008 pre-accept (HTTP 403). 2) decide accept subprotocol (`whisperer-bearer` iff token came via subprotocol). 3) validate `sid` -> else 1008 pre-accept. 4) acquire per-user slot (general pool) -> else accept + {t:error, code:retry_later} + close 1008. 5) voice gate + create voice_sessions row -> on refusal accept + {t:error, code} + close 1000. 6) accept(). 7) open Gemini Live session (model gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview, API v1alpha, server key) inside the shared Live-capacity slot. 8) send {t:ready, session_id}. 9) bidirectional relay until client disconnect, Gemini session end, 60 s of conversational inactivity, or model-requested farewell. 10) on normal end send {t:ended, reason}; on exception send {t:error, code:retry_later|voice_error}. 11) settle metering (wall clock since minted_at) and close() with 1000.
- **Protocol version:** none
- **Resume:** none at the socket level. Conversation memory lives server-side in the agent thread keyed by user_id + `sid`, so reconnecting with the same sid continues the dialogue (shared with text chat). Each connection mints a new voice_sessions metering row.

### Query parameters

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sid` | `string` | yes | Conversation (agent thread) id shared with the text chat channel, regex ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$. Not the metering session id. Missing/invalid -> close 1008 pre-accept. |

### Close codes

| Code | Reason | When | Source | Handled by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1008 | policy violation (pre-accept -> HTTP 403) | missing/invalid token | `backend/src/meetassist/api/ai/voice_ws.py:711` | — |
| 1008 | policy violation (pre-accept -> HTTP 403) | missing or invalid `sid` | `backend/src/meetassist/api/ai/voice_ws.py:723` | — |
| 1008 | policy violation, after accept, preceded by {t:error, code:retry_later} | per-user (8) or per-worker (500) socket cap reached | `backend/src/meetassist/api/ai/voice_ws.py:731` | — |
| 1000 | normal, after accept, preceded by {t:error, code:<gate code>} | voice gate refused (voice_disabled \| upgrade_required \| voice_switched_off) | `backend/src/meetassist/api/ai/voice_ws.py:741` | — |
| 1000 | normal (Starlette close() default) | end of every accepted session, after {t:ended} or {t:error} | `backend/src/meetassist/api/ai/voice_ws.py:779` | — |
| 1006 | abnormal closure (no close frame) | Observed by the client when the handler returns or raises after accept() without calling close(): uvicorn closes the TCP transport without a close frame. | `backend/Dockerfile:44` | — |
| 1011 | keepalive ping timeout (uvicorn) | Client does not answer protocol-level pings: uvicorn default --ws-ping-interval 20 s / --ws-ping-timeout 20 s (not overridden in the launch command). | `backend/Dockerfile:44` | — |
| 1012 | service restart (uvicorn) | Server shutdown while the socket is open (uvicorn closes open websockets immediately on SIGTERM). | `backend/src/meetassist/core/web/drain.py:7` | — |
| 1009 | message too big (protocol layer) | A single frame larger than --ws-max-size 12582912 bytes (12 MiB). | `backend/Dockerfile:44` | — |

### Handshake rejections

| HTTP status | Reason | When | Source | Handled by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 403 | HTTP 403 Forbidden instead of 101 (not a WS close code) | Any `ws.close(code=...)` issued BEFORE `ws.accept()`: uvicorn rejects the upgrade with HTTP 403, so the application close code (e.g. 1008) never reaches the client. Runtime: uvicorn[standard] (>=0.34; resolved 0.54 with websockets-sansio impl). | `backend/Dockerfile:44` | — |
| 503 | HTTP 503 `draining` before upgrade (not a WS close code) | Process drain marker file (/app/.drain) present: DrainMiddleware refuses every NEW websocket handshake with HTTP 503 body `draining` (nginx retries it on another upstream only under /v1/ws/); if the server lacked the websocket.http.response extension it would send close 1013 pre-accept, i.e. HTTP 403. | `backend/src/meetassist/core/web/drain.py:140` | — |

### Client → server frames

#### `audio`

json · class `web` · source `backend/src/meetassist/api/ai/voice_ws.py:548`

Microphone audio, sent continuously (silence included). Only text frames are read; binary frames, non-JSON, non-object, t != 'audio', empty or invalid base64 and frames over 262144 chars are dropped silently. The decoded bytes are forwarded to Gemini Live as `audio/pcm;rate=16000`. No other client frame types exist; the client ends the session by closing the socket.

| `d` | `string` | yes | Base64 of raw PCM16 mono 16 kHz (little-endian, as Gemini expects). |

## /v1/ws/voice-translate

- **Slice:** S05 · **class:** `native` · **source:** `backend/src/meetassist/api/ai/voice_translate_ws.py:312`
- **Consumers:** ios (3), linux (2), macos (3), whispererkit (8), windows (7)
- **Authentication:** `header:authorization-bearer`, `subprotocol:whisperer-bearer`. Bearer token (access JWT or device API key) in Authorization header, or `whisperer-bearer` subprotocol; plus ownership of a minted translation session No/invalid token or non-UUID sid: close(1008) pre-accept -> HTTP 403. Translate-pool slot refusal: accept, {t:error, code:retry_later}, close 1008. No Google Live key or row check failure: accept, {t:error, code:voice_disabled|forbidden|session_closed|session_expired}, close 1000.
- **Discriminator:** `t`
- **Handshake:** 1) resolve user -> else 1008 pre-accept. 2) parse sid UUID -> else 1008 pre-accept. 3) acquire slot in the separate `translate` pool (4 per user) -> else accept + {t:error, code:retry_later} + close 1008. 4) authorize the row (owner/minted/not expired; no key -> voice_disabled) -> else accept + {t:error, code} + close 1000. 5) accept(). 6) build the Gemini Live session for the row's model: gemini-3.5-live-translate-preview on API v1beta with translation config (target_lang), or the classic voice model on v1alpha with instruction + voice; inside the shared Live-capacity slot. 7) send {t:ready}. 8) relay until client disconnect, Gemini close, session window (expire_at) or client receive timeout. 9) on exception send {t:error, code:retry_later|voice_error}. 10) settle metering (wall clock since minted_at, FOR UPDATE, idempotent with the client's /usage) and close() 1000. No `ended` frame is sent.
- **Protocol version:** none
- **Resume:** none. A reconnect needs a still-minted, unexpired row; after the first socket settles the row (status settled) a reconnect with the same sid gets {t:error, code:session_closed}. The client must mint a new session via the HTTP token endpoint.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sid` | `string` | yes | UUID of the translation_sessions row minted by POST /v1/ai/voice-translate/token (one per direction). Non-UUID -> close 1008 pre-accept. |

## /v1/subtitles/stream

- **Slice:** S05 · **class:** `web` · **source:** `backend/src/meetassist/features/subtitles/channels/ws.py:288`
- **Consumers:** web (8)
- **Authentication:** `subprotocol:whisperer-room-pass`. LiveKit room pass (JWT) in Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: `whisperer-room-pass, <room JWT>` close(1008) before accept -> HTTP 403 for: no pass, invalid pass, LiveKit not configured, room missing/inactive, e2ee room, subscription_required, premium_budget_exhausted, quota_exhausted. No reason is returned.
- **Discriminator:** `type`
- **Handshake:** 1) read room pass from subprotocol -> empty: 1008 pre-accept. 2) authorize pass + room + entitlement (read-only DB session) -> failure: 1008 pre-accept (HTTP 403). 3) accept(subprotocol='whisperer-room-pass'). 4) client must send the hello JSON (text) within 300 s; `target_lang` is normalised (e.g. ru-RU -> ru) and must be one of the platform languages, else {type:error, code:language_unsupported}; if the OpenAI key is missing {type:error, code:unavailable}; in both cases the handler then returns (no close frame). 5) server sends {type:ready, target_lang}. 6) loop: binary frames = audio per slot, text frames = speech.end; every 30 s of streamed audio is metered to the room owner. One upstream OpenAI realtime translation socket is opened lazily per slot on first audio.
- **Protocol version:** none
- **Resume:** none. Each connection starts fresh; per-slot upstream sessions and pending line closers are torn down on disconnect; unmetered seconds are billed at disconnect.

## /v1/ws/user

- **Slice:** S09 · **class:** `native` · **source:** `backend/src/meetassist/features/proactive/channels/ws.py:54`
- **Consumers:** macos (3), web (6), whispererkit (7), windows (7)
- **Authentication:** `header:authorization-bearer`, `subprotocol:whisperer-bearer`. Bearer token (access JWT or device API key) in Authorization header, or `whisperer-bearer` subprotocol; then a mandatory `hello` first frame No/invalid token or slot refusal: close(1008) pre-accept -> HTTP 403. Invalid hello (wrong type, unknown client value, non-JSON, > 4096 chars): close 1008 after accept. No hello within 15 s: handler fails and the transport is dropped (no close frame).
- **Discriminator:** `type`
- **Handshake:** 1) resolve user -> else 1008 pre-accept. 2) acquire general-pool slot -> else 1008 pre-accept. 3) accept (echo whisperer-bearer if used). 4) client sends hello within 15 s -> invalid: close 1008. 5) server stores presence presence:user:<id>:<conn_id> = {client, chat_session_id} with TTL 80 s. 6) server replays undelivered reminders for this channel as `reminder.due` frames (web channel: also seeds the Leo chat thread). 7) concurrently: forward live frames from Redis channel push:user:<user_id> (only reminder.due addressed to this channel and reminder.settled) and read client ping/ack. On disconnect presence is deleted and the slot released.
- **Protocol version:** none
- **Resume:** Durable delivery: every reminder has a proactive_deliveries row per channel (UNIQUE nudge_id+channel, statuses pending -> pushed -> acked/settled/failed/expired). On every hello the server replays open deliveries for the connecting channel: durable kinds (errand_due with evidence.explicit, mail_important, connection_broken, commitment_due), created in the last 24 h, unread, not held by quiet hours, not acked/settled by any channel, attempts < 10; max 20 nudges, oldest first; a desktop channel gets nothing while a web client is present. A background sweep re-publishes pushed-but-unacked deliveries after 30 s while the channel is present. Clients must ack each delivery_id; the first ack settles all other channels' deliveries and broadcasts reminder.settled.

_None._

## /v1/ws/demo-translate

- **Slice:** S17 · **class:** `web` · **source:** `backend/src/meetassist/features/demo/channels/translate_ws.py:323`
- **Consumers:** landing (1)
- **Authentication:** `none`. none (anonymous landing-page demo); access is limited by a per-IP and platform-wide seconds budget Every refusal is AFTER accept: accept() (no subprotocol), send {t:error, code}, close 1008. Codes: translate_bad_mode | translate_bad_lang | translate_bad_voice | translate_disabled | visitor_limit | demo_unavailable.
- **Discriminator:** `t`
- **Handshake:** 1) build DemoSettings, resolve client IP. 2) validate mode/target_lang/voice and compute the session window = min(remaining budget for the mode, DEMO_TRANSLATE_MAX_SESSION_SECONDS=90) -> on DemoError: accept + {t:error, code} + close 1008. 3) Google Live key missing -> accept + {t:error, code:demo_unavailable} + close 1008. 4) accept(). 5) take a shared Live-capacity slot and connect Gemini Live for the mode. 6) send {t:ready, seconds:<window>}. 7) start the budget meter: charges 5 s AHEAD (Redis INCRBY on visitor and platform counters), sleeps 5 s, then sends {t:left, seconds}; repeats until the window is served or a charge is refused ({t:error, code:visitor_limit|platform_limit|counter_unavailable}). 8) relay audio/transcripts until client disconnect, Gemini close, meter end, or client receive timeout. 9) on exception send {t:error, code:busy|demo_unavailable}. 10) close(1000). No `ended` frame.
- **Protocol version:** none
- **Resume:** none. Budget is server-side per IP and per mode per UTC day; reconnecting starts a new session whose window is the remaining budget (capped at 90 s). Seconds charged ahead are not refunded on disconnect. GET /v1/demo/translate/budget (HTTP) returns the remaining seconds per mode.

### Query parameters

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `string` | yes | `classic` (turn-based engine gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview on API v1alpha, selectable voice) \| `live` (continuous engine gemini-3.5-live-translate-preview on API v1beta, voice ignored). Trimmed and lower-cased; anything else -> translate_bad_mode. |
| `target_lang` | `string` | yes | Target language, one of ru en de es fr zh pt it ja ko hi ar id tr vi th (trimmed, lower-cased); else translate_bad_lang. |
| `voice` | `string` | no | Synthesis voice for classic mode: `Zephyr` (default) \| `Orus`, case-sensitive after trim; else translate_bad_voice. |

### Close codes

| Code | Reason | When | Source | Handled by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1008 | policy violation, after accept, preceded by {t:error, code} | bad mode/lang/voice, translation disabled, no budget left (visitor_limit) | `backend/src/meetassist/features/demo/channels/translate_ws.py:333` | — |
| 1008 | policy violation, after accept, preceded by {t:error, code:demo_unavailable} | Google Live API key not configured | `backend/src/meetassist/features/demo/channels/translate_ws.py:340` | — |
| 1000 | normal | end of every accepted session: window served, budget exhausted mid-session, client gone, Gemini closed, client receive timeout, or after {t:error} on failure | `backend/src/meetassist/features/demo/channels/translate_ws.py:366` | — |
| 1006 | abnormal closure (no close frame) | Observed by the client when the handler returns or raises after accept() without calling close(): uvicorn closes the TCP transport without a close frame. | `backend/Dockerfile:44` | — |
| 1011 | keepalive ping timeout (uvicorn) | Client does not answer protocol-level pings: uvicorn default --ws-ping-interval 20 s / --ws-ping-timeout 20 s (not overridden in the launch command). | `backend/Dockerfile:44` | — |
| 1012 | service restart (uvicorn) | Server shutdown while the socket is open (uvicorn closes open websockets immediately on SIGTERM). | `backend/src/meetassist/core/web/drain.py:7` | — |
| 1009 | message too big (protocol layer) | A single frame larger than --ws-max-size 12582912 bytes (12 MiB). | `backend/Dockerfile:44` | — |
